description: This file contains assembly code for the QNNPACK library, specifically an optimized AArch64 NEON kernel for packing matrix A in sparse int8 GEMM operations. It defines the function 'pytorch_q8gemm_sparse_packA_ukernel_8x4__aarch64_neon' responsible for loading, transposing, and packing blocks of matrix A data for efficient matrix multiplication on ARM64 architectures.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_sparse_packA_ukernel_8x4__aarch64_neon
methods.description: Assembly function that packs a block of matrix A into a format suitable for sparse GEMM, performing loading, transposing, and storing of 8x4 blocks, optimized for ARM AArch64 NEON instructions.
